{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient rows, keeping the one with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures we only use the most recent test for each patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter for patients with severe disease
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Identify sentinel values
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Exclude rows where biomarker_baseline is the sentinel value
severe_clean = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients (excluding sentinel)
mean_biomarker_severe_clean = severe_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Confirm the number of valid observations
n_valid = len(severe_clean)

# Output the result
mean_biomarker_severe_clean, n_valid"}
